name: The Hermit's Antidote
description: Gather Mire Glands for a hermit living at the edge of Mistfen.

dialogue.offer: Mistfen's vapors are worsening. Four Mire Glands will make enough antidote for both of us.
dialogue.in_progress: The largest toads carry the strongest glands. Watch the pools.
dialogue.ready: Keep your distance while I prepare these. The fumes bite.
dialogue.completed: Breathe deeply. The fen cannot poison you today.
